confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on aggregated blog and listing price guides, which are mixed in quality and undated, so they are rough. Cocktail and wine are bounded using beer-to-drink relationships and cafe/bar price guides. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings. The FX rate is from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened and the value could not be cross-checked against the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Holistic basis: mid-sized Latin American capital with a strong tourist accommodation market, low restaurant prices for menu-del-dia style meals, and a higher-priced upscale bar and cafe segment in districts such as Miraflores.
